title_zh: 研究加速：参差不齐的前沿
summary_en: OpenAI evaluated coding agents on their ability to accelerate AI research tasks. The results reveal a jagged frontier: agents perform well on some research subtasks but poorly on others, showing uneven capability. This unevenness has implications for recursive self-improvement, as agents cannot yet reliably automate the full research loop. The article discusses where performance is strong versus weak and what this means for AI-driven AI progress.
summary_zh: OpenAI 评估了编码智能体（coding agents）加速 AI 研究任务的能力。结果揭示了一个“参差不齐的前沿”：智能体在某些研究子任务上表现良好，但在其他任务上表现不佳，能力分布不均。这种不均衡对递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement）具有启示意义，因为智能体尚不能可靠地自动化完整的研究循环。文章讨论了性能强弱的具体领域及其对 AI 驱动 AI 进展的意义。
content_en: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.
content_zh: OpenAI 衡量编程智能体如何加速 AI 研究、其表现仍在哪些方面参差不齐，以及这对递归自我改进意味着什么。
